```{r}

### Global params 


# Number of trials per simulation
trials <- 120  

# Number of agents to simulate
agents <- 100  

# set seed
 set.seed(2001)


```



```{r}

### Win Stay Lose Shift agent -- from Riccardo 


agent_wsls <- function(prevChoice, feedback, noise = 0) { ## Implementation of probabilistic version
  # Input validation
  if (!prevChoice %in% c(0, 1)) stop("Previous choice must be 0 or 1.")
  if (!feedback %in% c(0, 1)) stop("Feedback must be 0 or 1.")
  if (!is.numeric(noise) || noise < 0 || noise > 1) stop("Noise must be a probability between 0 and 1.")

  # Core WSLS logic:
  # If feedback is 1 (win), stay: choice = prevChoice
  # If feedback is 0 (loss), shift: choice = 1 - prevChoice
  choice <- ifelse(feedback == 1, prevChoice, 1 - prevChoice)

  # Apply noise if specified
  if (noise > 0 && runif(1) < noise) {
    # Override with a random 50/50 choice
    choice <- sample(c(0, 1), 1)
  }

  return(choice)
}


```




```{r}


### Reinforcement Learning agent 


agent_rl <- function(prevChoice, feedback, omega = 0.1) {
  
  # Input validation 
  if (!feedback %in% c(0, 0.5, 1)) stop("Feedback must be 0 or 1. (or init value)")
  if (!is.numeric(omega) || omega < 0 || omega > 1) stop("Omega must be between 0 and 1.")
  
  # Create current choice based on previous choice and feedback
  
  choice_prob <- prevChoice + omega*(feedback - prevChoice)
  
  # enter choice in bernoulli distribution to get a binary choice
  
  choice <- rbinom(1, 1, choice_prob)
  
  return(list(choice = choice, choice_prob = choice_prob))
  
} 


#### IMPLEMENT EXTRACTION OF CHOICE PROB

```


```{r}

## Setting initial choices 
# WSLS random choice 

wsls_init <- sample(c(0, 1), 1)

# For RL, random as well 
prevChoice_init <- 0.5 
feedback_init_RL <- 0.5

feedback_init_WSLS <- 1 # Start on a win

# Setting up vectors for data storage 
wsls_choices_vs_rl <- rep(NA, trials)
feedback_vs_rl <- rep(NA, trials)
rl_choices_vs_wsls <- rep(NA, trials)
feedback_vs_wsls <- rep(NA, trials)
choice_probs_rl <- rep(NA, trials)

## Insert first choices
wsls_choices_vs_rl[1] <- agent_wsls(wsls_init, feedback_init_WSLS)

# RL agent returning choice and choice probability
rl_result_init <- agent_rl(prevChoice_init, feedback_init_RL)
rl_choices_vs_wsls[1] <- rl_result_init$choice
choice_probs_rl[1] <- rl_result_init$choice_prob  # Store the initial prob

## Setup game loop 
for (t in 2:trials) {
  
  ## Setup who is the matcher 
  prev_feedback1 <- ifelse(wsls_choices_vs_rl[t - 1] == rl_choices_vs_wsls[t - 1], 1, 0)
  feedback_vs_rl[t - 1] <- prev_feedback1
  
  # Feedback for agent 2 
  prev_feedback2 <- 1 - prev_feedback1
  feedback_vs_wsls[t - 1] <- prev_feedback2
  
  ## WSLS updating based on feedback from previous round 
  wsls_choices_vs_rl[t] <- agent_wsls(wsls_choices_vs_rl[t-1], 
                                      prev_feedback1,
                                      noise = 0.9)
  
  ## RL updating based on feedback from previous round
  choice_rl <- agent_rl(choice_probs_rl[t-1],  
                        prev_feedback2,
                        omega = 0.1) ## LEARNING RATE TWEAK THIS
  
  rl_choices_vs_wsls[t] <- choice_rl$choice
  choice_probs_rl[t] <- choice_rl$choice_prob
}

#  dataframe creation
df_vs_rl <- tibble(
  trial = 1:trials,
  Self_WSLS = wsls_choices_vs_rl,
  Opponent_RL = rl_choices_vs_wsls,
  Feedback_WSLS = feedback_vs_rl,
  Feedback_RL = feedback_vs_wsls,
  Choice_Prob_RL = choice_probs_rl  
) %>% mutate(
  Cumulative_Performance = cumsum(Feedback_WSLS) / row_number()
)

## Viz
p_choices_wsls <- ggplot(df_vs_rl, aes(x = trial)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Self_WSLS, color = "WSLS Agent")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Opponent_RL + 0.05, color = "RL Agent"), linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "WSLS vs. RL (0.9 LR)", y = "Choice (0/1)") + 
  theme_cowplot() + 
  ylim(-0.1, 1.1)

p_perf_wsls <- ggplot(df_vs_rl, aes(x = trial, y = Cumulative_Performance)) +
  geom_line(color = "purple", size = 1) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "WSLS Performance vs. RL (0.9 LR)", y = "Proportion Wins") + 
  theme_cowplot() + 
  ylim(0, 1)


library(gridExtra)
grid.arrange(p_choices_wsls, p_perf_wsls, nrow = 2)

# Plot choice probabilities 
p_choice_prob <- ggplot(df_vs_rl, aes(x = trial, y = Choice_Prob_RL)) +  # FIX 4: Use the column name
  geom_line(color = "blue", size = 1) + 
  labs(title = "RL Agent Choice Probability of Choosing 1 (0.9 LR)", 
       y = "Choice Probability") + 
  theme_cowplot() + 
  ylim(0, 1)

p_choice_prob

```
